name: Sengoku ages screens on the 15 km Japan map: the human house (Takeda) sees the era-name change (改元) screen at Koji (turn 66) with its judged age and 元号, the era indicator tooltip (bottom right) names the Koji era with the turns to Eiroku, the screen closes, and the era score screen (the official era progress panel from the top panel button) shows the ledger: period, merit by category, thresholds, turns to the next era name and the past judgement; force the human dark just before Koji and check a single choice popup, ledger-based end-turn blocking, notification reopen, unblock after choosing and no next-turn change

steps.code: local l = Game:GetProperty('JAC_AGES_LEDGER'); if type(l) ~= 'table' then error('no ledger property') end; local elapsed = Game.GetCurrentGameTurn() - GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn() + 1; local takeda; for _, p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do if PlayerConfigurations[p:GetID()]:GetCivilizationTypeName() == 'CIVILIZATION_JAC_TAKEDA' then takeda = p:GetID() end end; if takeda == nil then error('Takeda (the human) not alive') end; local h = l.houses['p' .. takeda]; local defaults = {}; for row in GameInfo.JAC_SengokuDarkAgePolicyDefaults() do defaults[row.CivilizationType] = row.PolicyType end; local function flags(id, policy) local anchors = 0; for _, c in Players[id]:GetCities():Members() do local plot = Map.GetPlot(c:GetX(), c:GetY()); for row in GameInfo.JAC_SengokuDarkAgePolicies() do local on = row.PolicyType == policy; if (plot:GetProperty(row.PolicyType) or 0) ~= (on and 1 or 0) then error(row.PolicyType .. ' flag of ' .. id .. ' (policy ' .. tostring(policy) .. ')') end; local a = plot:GetProperty((string.gsub(row.PolicyType, '^JAC_AGE_POLICY_', 'JAC_AGE_ANCHOR_'))) or 0; if a ~= 0 and not on then error('stray anchor of ' .. id) end; anchors = anchors + a end end; if Players[id]:GetCities():GetCount() > 0 and anchors ~= 1 then error('anchors of ' .. id .. ': ' .. anchors) end end; if elapsed ~= 65 or l.reign ~= 0 then error('not turn 65 before Koji: ' .. elapsed .. ' reign ' .. l.reign) end; if defaults.CIVILIZATION_JAC_TAKEDA == 'JAC_AGE_POLICY_TEMPLE' then error('the test chooses Temple Learning, which must not be the default') end; h.score = -1000; Game:SetProperty('JAC_AGES_LEDGER', l); return 'turn 65: forced Takeda (player ' .. takeda .. ') to score -1000 before the Koji judgement'
